resources.string: SystemUI hook detection will be connected in the next implementation step.
Maps the physical 20–80% battery range into a displayed 0–100% scale.
Turns Battery Saver on at 20% displayed level, off above 50%, and keeps it off while charging.
Starts a 30-second shutdown countdown when the physical battery reaches 20%. Charging cancels it.
Settings are saved locally. Hook integration is intentionally not included in this UI-only patch.
The status bar, Quick Settings, and lock screen will temporarily disappear while SystemUI restarts. Root access is required.
